note: Schedule per demo.md: prepare runs the real fine-tuning job (queue time can be minutes to hours; do not resubmit a queued job). Do not edit the dataset, thresholds or prompts to improve the result: DO NOT PROMOTE is a valid outcome. The 'job' screen also needs the terminal line 'fine-tuned model: ...ft-...' from submit (read it from build/job.json in a terminal, suffix masked). Developer deployments expire after 24 hours.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-09 -l swedencentral -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-09 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-09 failed' }
# owner reads the training price per million tokens for gpt-4.1-mini from the Azure OpenAI pricing page (not shown on camera)
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
if (-not (Test-Path build/job.json)) { python -m fttriage prepare --out build --price-per-million $env:FT_PRICE_PER_MILLION | Out-Null; python -m fttriage submit --endpoint $env:AOAI --out build }

screens.name: prepare
mask: do not show the pricing page

screens.name: job
steps: Open the resource in rg-mglab-ai-09 > Fine-tuning and open the finished job
Show status Succeeded, base model gpt-4.1-mini, training type Standard
Open the metrics view: training loss and full validation loss and accuracy
Then show in a terminal: (Get-Content build/job.json | ConvertFrom-Json).fine_tuned_model with the id suffix masked
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu
no Cost Management blade or pricing page

screens.name: deployments
steps: Open Models + endpoints (or Azure portal > the Azure OpenAI resource > Deployments)
Show 'base' (gpt-4.1-mini 2025-04-14, Standard) and 'triage-ft' (fine-tuned, deployment type Developer, state Succeeded)
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-09 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
